name: A · 紫霄玄袖
summary: 银发道冠 · 大扇袖 · 神秘自信
detail: Closest to user inspiration but unmistakably Chinese. Mysterious confident woman, short oval face with one lifted wedge eyebrow, half-open almond eyes, subtle sly smile; silver-white long hair in TWO broad flowing masses, simple three-panel short fringe. A dark-purple Chinese cloud-shaped DAO CROWN with two smooth upward curved ornamental fins, fitted on a small tied crown section; fins are clearly a crown, not growing horns. Violet/ink-purple/ivory/muted old gold, one teal accent. FITTED high diagonal-cross-collar inner top shaped smoothly over fuller bust, dark tapered waist band, two long clean violet robe panels over dark riding leggings and simple purple boots. TWO huge rounded fan-shaped trumpet sleeves inspired by reference, each one uninterrupted broad shape; ONE large teal/lilac butterfly-like CLOUD motif spanning only the outward sleeve, no intricate butterfly scales or stars. Two broad trailing ribbons not many hairlike strips. POSE gently open arms at unequal heights, one hand lifted holding exactly TWO separated pale yellow talisman papers with a few cinnabar abstract brush marks, other hand lowered sideways holding a purple-jade handled white fly whisk; whisk handle and single grouped white tail physically connected. A slow flowing S-line, both feet apart with one knee relaxed, grounded not flying. Silhouette wide soft arcs and fluttering sleeve wings; all ornaments greatly simplified.
prompt: Create ONE distinct new ADULT FEMALE CHINESE TAOIST game companion, mid twenties. Image1 is user inspiration for dramatic wide-sleeve silhouette, flowing hair and designed tailoring, NOT an exact costume to copy. Adapt its feeling into Chinese Taoist robes/collars/crowns/talismans and proper Chinese implements, not a Western sorceress or elf. Human ears, no animal horns or bat-wing crown. Image2 is the project's AUTHORITATIVE GEM-ICON painting style, head/body proportion and feminine curve reference. Match compact roughly FOUR HEADS crown-to-sole (excluding crown/hair), not image1's long-legged anime fashion proportions. Fuller natural rounded adult bust, shaped waist and feminine hips via intentional tailored opaque garments, agile not bulky or muscle-plate chest; mature face with individual graphic personality rather than a copied glamour face. Bold clean dark contour with line-weight hierarchy, large coherent colored planes and 2-3 material shadow groups, very sparse broad highlights, soft organic skin/cloth; no tiny triangle mosaic, realistic irises, thin-line elaborate filigree or 3D gloss. Eyes simple graphic pupils with at most one small highlight. One or two large motif focal zones, most cloth calm solid shapes. Chinese costume construction and distinctive court/folk-Taoist personality. Props in hands must be complete, correct five fingers and grip, only described items. Body/face three-quarter SCREEN LEFT, TWO separately readable legs/feet in a natural mildly dynamic pose, no hidden second leg/parallel stiff pose or extra limbs. Full body and ALL sleeves/hair/cloth tails/props safely inside square warm ivory #F4EFDF background with 8% margin, no scenery, ground shadow, text labels, panels or other figures.
